faq_intro: What VideoLoad does, what Pro adds, and where the limits are.
faq: What is VideoLoad?

VideoLoad is a mobile video download browser built around downloading videos, watching videos and trimming clips. Start free without an app account. Download only supported material you own or may save. Browsing history and activity records stay on your device. We do not collect or upload these records to our servers. Pro unlocks compatible MP4/GIF clip export and independently controlled two-video playback.
Is VideoLoad free? Is Pro a subscription?

Store editions are free to start. Pro is an optional one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription. It adds local video import, two-video comparison, compatible MP4/GIF clip export and removal of the two-unfinished-download limit. Your local store shows the price. The direct Android edition has separate feature rules.
What counts toward the two-download limit?
Unfinished tasks, including paused and failed tasks, count. Completed and cancelled tasks do not. Task count does not guarantee simultaneous connections or download speed.
Does VideoLoad collect my browsing history or activity records?

VideoLoad places no ads in its own interface and requires no app account. Browsing history and activity records stay on your device. We do not collect or upload these records to our servers. Browsing and downloading still contact the websites and media hosts you choose. Those websites may show ads and use cookies.
Can it download from every website?

No. Website, server and format compatibility varies. Only download material you own or may save. The app does not bypass DRM, paywalls or access controls. The Google Play edition does not support YouTube downloads.
Can every video be exported to MP4 or GIF?

No. Export requires Pro and a compatible source. On iOS, local HLS offline packages play in the app but cannot export to MP4/GIF, be shared as files or be saved to Photos. iOS GIF selections can total up to 30 seconds.
Are the two players synchronized?
Each player has independent controls. Two-video comparison does not guarantee frame-accurate synchronization.
Can I install VideoLoad on iPhone now?
The iPhone version is coming soon, with App Store submission in progress. There is no public App Store download link here yet. A verified official link will be added after release.
Can one Pro purchase unlock Android and iPhone?
No. Purchases are platform-specific and do not transfer between Android and iOS. Use the original store account to recover purchases; on iOS, choose Restore Purchases on the Pro screen.
Why might an iOS download stop in the background?
iOS schedules background transfers and force-quitting stops them. Reopen the app to resume a supported source; reuse of completed data depends on the source server and format.

download_sections.title: Which edition should I choose?
paragraphs: The Google Play edition is free to start with optional one-time Pro. Availability depends on store review, rollout and region. The official direct APK is a separate Chinese-branded Android app with its own updates and currently unlocked features. These are different app packages; store purchases do not transfer between them.

download_sections.title: Install on Android
paragraphs: Android 8.0 or later is required. Use an official entry above. For an APK, Android may ask you to allow installation from your browser or file manager. Enable this only when needed for this installation and turn it off afterward. Do not disable system protection.

download_sections.title: iPhone is coming soon
paragraphs: App Store submission is in progress. This page will add a verified App Store link after release. No iOS installation file is distributed here.

download_sections.title: Free and Pro
paragraphs: Free store features include browsing, up to two unfinished downloads, playback, clip marking and looping. Paused or failed tasks count; completed or cancelled tasks do not.

Pro unlocks local import, independent dual-video comparison, compatible MP4/GIF export and removal of the task limit. It is a one-time in-app purchase, not a subscription. Your store shows the local price. Android and iOS purchases are separate. Use the original store account to recover a purchase; on iOS use Restore Purchases.

download_sections.title: Try a video you are allowed to save
paragraphs: In the app browser, open our original demo media page and download the MP4 using the floating download button. Open the completed video, mark 1–3 seconds and 9–11 seconds, then try marked-only playback. Loop controls differ between platforms. Pro adds compatible export and two-video comparison.
